title: Jack Rabbit Rachael Rabbit Orange, Mango and Passionfruit E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: Rachael Rabbit’s Orange, Mango & Passionfruit is a sublime tropical and a holiday in a 10ml bottle. Fresh and juicy oranges and mangoes greet you on the inhale followed by the deep and tangy sweetness of Passionfruit, all finished to exquisite perfection with a cooling jolt of menthol ice. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks .
